utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on the latest, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you keeping an ear out. Just send me any updates when you hear them, and I’ll keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’m still pinning down what we’re short on, but if you can bring basic tools and maybe a few extra hands, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks — if you can bring those, that’d be a big help. I’m still hunting for my toolbox, so I may need a hand with the little fixes too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I can bring a couple extra tools and help with the little fixes too. Just tell me where to meet you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, I may have missed an update, but I think they’re still collecting things for the repair drive. I don’t know the full list yet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — that helps. If you hear anything else about what they still need for the repair drive, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Any update on the date, time, and repair list yet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa said the repair drive is at the community center on Sunday, and she’ll send the address as soon as she has it. I’m still waiting on the latest repair list, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll make sure everyone has the updated details. What do you need from me, Mara?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I still need the updated repair list and confirmation on the time, and I’ll share it as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Do we have the date, time, and repair list for the drive yet? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet either—can you confirm if the repair list is finalized?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send me the exact address when you have it, and I’ll bring the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest—did the repair drive pick up any new volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair list over as soon as I have it, and I’ll keep passing along any updates too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear about the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help sort the donations and label the boxes once we’ve got the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam—that would be a huge help. I’ll keep an ear out for the latest on the repair drive and let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I still don’t have the date, time, or repair list yet, but I can bring a couple of tools once you’ve got them set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I’m still waiting on the full list too, so I’ll let you know as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli — if you could bring tools and a bit of tape, that would help. I’m still waiting on the date, time, and repair list, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. Just let me know the date and time when you have them, and I’ll be ready.
